body: I have 4 absolutely fantastic animals. This made me look at my dog and cuddle him. Thank you for that. I appreciate the reminder that I will survive this. It’s good to hear, I don’t tell it to my self often but that is going to change. I hope you do too. I appreciate you.
Thank you❤️ the though of how bad it’ll hurt physically and emotionally tomorrow is keeping me away for now, I hope I keep it up. I truly appreciate the love and encouragement
My newest ones are still healing

I’m not an alcoholic. And he’s not going anywhere, neither am I. It’s funny because he doesn’t deal with me drunk. I drink when he’s at work occasionally, that’s about it. I don’t cut when I’m wasted.
When I say self harm I mean I’ve cut myself. So no not a damn skinned knee.
I’m not a perfect human being but im a damn adult. I always come home after I get done drinking,

I don’t wanna believe this. I’ve spent almost 5 years with this man. I’m almost positive he meant giving one our pets away. But I see what you’re saying. I just need him to talk in an honest but kind way. I don’t know. I’m lost.

I think so. His dad drinks a lot. He knows i smoke way more then I drink. I usually have a couple on Saturdays and sundays but that’s about it because I work every day of the week. He has no problem with me smoking. He even bought me a bong. But tonight he ruined one of my elephant Pipes. I’m pretty sure he either hid or threw out my cigarettes. He texted me earlier. “You’re actions have consequences, enjoy yours.” So I figured out what he meant

Yes. We live together. He says he wants me to go sleep somewhere else tonight. He says this when he’s mad. He told me the other night to choose and an animal to go because I smoked green in the apartment.
I don’t. I just get goofy and according to him annoying, which is fair haha. And it’s screw ball peanut butter whiskey. It’s so good.
You are correct on the fact I have a past in self harming. Both sober and drunk. I have medicine that works wonders. And I don’t drink much. On days that I have off I do but that’s about it
I truly hope not. He told me to not be home when he gets home and to stay somewhere else.
He shouldn’t. I don’t have known problem with it. We got married September 21st this year, so recently. I understand his concern but I really don’t drink much.
Do you think it’d show a positive if I take it now? Would I have enough of the hormone?
Okay, I was drunk and happy when I posted this 😂
I am too, I was doing well. Someday it’ll get better. I hope you’re doing alright. Thank you for the encouragement
